title: 36 Hours in Tokyo
abstract: Besides joining the crowds on Tokyo’s shopper-clogged streets, you can take a cruise, see a Buddhist temple or partake of a kaiseki dinner on the 45th floor of a luxury hotel.

title: 36 Hours in Las Vegas
abstract: Yoga among dolphins? A museum of neon? Of course! This is Las Vegas, where a weekend can include almost anything.

title: 36 Hours in Texas Hill Country
abstract: Just west of Austin you’ll find the Hill Country, an area home to Comfort and Welfare, the echoes of Willie and Waylon and the tension between rural and refined.

title: 36 Hours in Auckland, New Zealand
abstract: Sure, you could fly here and head straight for the movie tourism trail. But why miss everything that the country’s largest city has to offer?

title: 36 Hours in Jackson, Miss.
abstract: From restaurants to writers, Mississippi’s capital city offers a textured mix of old and new.
